air_valve_application_rows.interpretation: A repeated room/air-valve line is a distinct printed schedule application. A blank or dash value is retained as printed; no actuator, motor, fail position or BAS I/O is inferred from this schedule.
notes: (-) is transfer into the space; (+) is transfer out of the space; no value is neutral.
The east/west application lists total 157 printed schedule rows (85 west, 72 east).

damper_actuator_schedule.note: M-001/M-801 distinguish dampers and motor-operated dampers, while M-601 lists air valves and volume-damper accessories. No damper actuator tags, torque, model, control signal or fail position are tabulated.
